main.description: Looks up an indexed EVM-link record by exact AT-URI and hydrates its actor. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full AT-URI of an app.certified.link.evm record with a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not an app.certified.link.evm record AT-URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed EVM-link record exists at this AT-URI.

evmLinkView.description: Indexed EVM-link record with its original address and proof, and the linked actor's hydrated Certified records.

indexedAt.description: Index timestamp, or null when the indexed row has no timestamp.
